inputs.loading: Checking what is already known about your field…
inputs.status.title: Ready to compare?
inputs.status.rotation.set: Rotation: set from your own entry or your confirmed history.
inputs.status.rotation.default: Rotation: not set yet. Confirm your history, edit the rotation below, or accept what the satellites suggest.
inputs.status.soil.set: Soil: set from satellite maps or your own values.
inputs.status.soil.default: Soil: only defaults so far. Enter your soil test values or accept the defaults below.
inputs.status.ready: Everything the comparison needs is set.
inputs.status.ready.defaults: You accepted the defaults shown, so the comparison can run. It will be less certain until you enter your own values.
inputs.status.blocked: The comparison waits until the rotation and soil are set, or you accept the defaults shown.
inputs.rotation.title: Your current rotation
inputs.rotation.body: The crops you grow in turn, season by season, repeating. Every comparison is measured against it.
inputs.rotation.source.confirmed: Taken from the seasons you confirmed in your field's history.
inputs.rotation.source.inferred: Suggested by the satellites and not confirmed. Check it, or confirm your history first.
inputs.rotation.source.none: No rotation yet. Add a season, or confirm your field's history.
inputs.soil.title: Your soil
inputs.soil.body: Values come from satellite soil maps. If you have a soil test, type its numbers: yours replace the maps and are saved with the field.
inputs.soil.awc: Water the soil can hold for plants
inputs.soil.origin.default: Default value ({source}). Replace it with your own if you can.
inputs.soil.reset.aria: Go back to the map value for {property}
inputs.priorities.title: What matters most to you
inputs.constraints.title: Your limits
inputs.constraints.body: Rotations that break one of these are left out of the comparison, and each left-out crop says why.
inputs.irrigation.title: Irrigation
inputs.irrigation.none.hint: Rain only. Crops that need irrigation are left out.
inputs.irrigation.supplemental.hint: A little extra water now and then.
inputs.irrigation.full.hint: Water whenever the crop needs it.
inputs.irrigation.cap.hint: Leave empty if you do not know. This is a limit you set, not a recommendation.
inputs.irrigation.cap.error: Enter a number of 0 or more.
inputs.farm.title: Your farm
inputs.crops.title: Crops
inputs.crops.hint: Uncheck "I can sell it" where there is no market. Check "Leave it out" for crops you never want considered.
inputs.gate.title: Set your rotation and soil first
inputs.gate.body: The comparison needs to know what you grow now and your soil. Enter them, or accept the defaults shown on the inputs page.
